events.title: Largest company on September 30?
events.description: This is a market over which company will be the largest by market cap at market close on September 30, 2024.

markets.question: Will AAPL be the largest company by mcap on September 30?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Apple (AAPL) is the largest company in the world by market cap at market close on September 30, 2024. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

markets.question: Will MSFT be the largest company by mcap on September 30?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Microsoft (MSFT) is the largest company in the world by market cap at market close on September 30, 2024. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

markets.question: Will NVDA be the largest company by mcap on September 30?
markets.description:

markets.question: Will another company be the largest company by mcap on September 30?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if any company other than Apple (AAPL), Microsoft (MSFT), or Nvidia (NVDA) is the largest company in the world by market cap at market close on September 30, 2024. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.
